title: T9 — Project context diagram (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Context Diagram — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Context

T9 is the programme's architecture capability: it defines the ADM phases, the artefact and link
model, the architecture contracts, the compliance review, the waiver register, the Architecture
Board, maturity and skills. It sits inside tenant `nonagentic`, programme
`01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`, tranche 4.

## Affected organisation

| Actor | Role |
|---|---|
| Programme architect (`conveyor-e2e`) | delivery and the record |
| `conveyor-approver` | approval, distinct from the requester |
| Architecture Board (`conveyor-architecture-board`) | decides A–D artefacts and the contract |
| Programme board | reviews the tranche |

## Affected systems

- **conveyor store** — the eleven ADM tables of §10.3 and the 26 `architecture.*` actions.
- **the architecture screens** — the ADM destination of §10.5 and the contracts/reviews views.
- **the seed** — the adopted ADM profile and artefact standard the phases read.
- **T10 and T12** — the delivery gates and the one-organisation-loop acceptance that depend on
  this capability's contracts and compliance levels.
